In the center of the aisle, a person is walking past the shelves. Above the person, two hot air balloons are hanging from the ceiling. The person is wearing a white jacket and black pants, and appears to be walking towards the aisle. The background is blurred, but it seems like the store is well-lit with natural light coming in from the windows.
